summary: Features a site or an app can offer. Some are rules of the referential (marked in checks); the others are options to propose when they fit.

entries.what: Asks consent before non-essential cookies, with refuse as easy as accept.
entries.use_when: Only when the site sets non-essential cookies or trackers.
entries.avoid_when: Sites with essential cookies only: no banner needed.
entries.build: Accept and refuse buttons of equal weight on the first layer, nothing set before consent, choice changeable from the footer. Free: a self-hosted consent script or the analytics' cookieless mode.

entries.what: A button next to a value copies it and confirms with a check.
entries.use_when: API keys, invitation links, codes, commands, addresses, IBAN shown to the owner.
entries.avoid_when: Ordinary text people do not need to reuse.
entries.build: navigator.clipboard.writeText; the icon becomes a check for about 2 s; announced by aria-live.

entries.what: A print stylesheet that removes menus and buttons and keeps the content readable on paper.
entries.use_when: Invoices, receipts, recipes, tickets, legal pages, documentation.
entries.build: @media print: hide navigation and actions, black on white, URLs after links, page breaks avoided inside blocks.

entries.what: A button in the password field shows what was typed.
entries.build: A toggle button with aria-pressed that switches type=password and text without clearing the field.

entries.what: Links shared on social networks or in emails carry utm_ parameters, read by the analytics tool to know which campaign brought each visitor.
entries.use_when: Sites with an analytics tool and campaigns on several channels.
entries.avoid_when: Sites without analytics: nobody reads the parameters.
entries.build: Add utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to shared links; make sure redirects keep the query string; a privacy-friendly analytics tool (Plausible or Umami self-hosted, Matomo) reads them.

entries.what: After sending a form, a clear message says what happens next and when.
entries.build: Replace the form with a message or show a success state that stays; email confirmation for orders and bookings.

entries.what: Pages show when their content was last changed.
entries.build: From the content's real change date, not the build date; <time datetime>.

entries.what: Questions shown as a list, each answer opening on click.
entries.avoid_when: When people need to read every answer (show them open).
entries.build: <details><summary> works without JavaScript and is accessible; FAQPage structured data only where Google still shows it.

entries.what: A dark theme that follows the system or the user's choice.
entries.avoid_when: Only when it would be an inverted copy of the light theme.
entries.build: Built tokens for dark, color-scheme set, images and shadows checked in dark.

entries.what: Grey shapes of the real layout while a page loads.
entries.build: Same dimensions as the final content; delayed 150 to 300 ms.

entries.what: The screen changes at once and is corrected if the server refuses.
entries.build: Update local state, send, roll back with a message or Undo on failure.

entries.what: After an action, a toast offers to undo it for a few seconds.
entries.use_when: Deletes and moves that can be reversed.
entries.build: Soft delete, toast of 5 to 10 s with Undo, focusable; Sonner (MIT).

entries.what: A dialog asks to confirm an action that cannot be undone, naming what will be lost.
entries.build: The button says the action ("Delete 3 invoices"), not "OK"; typing the name for very destructive actions.

entries.what: A long answer appears as it is produced, with a way to stop it.
entries.build: Server-sent events or a ReadableStream; a Stop button; the final text announced once.

entries.what: Work is saved as the user types, with a discreet saved state.
entries.avoid_when: Actions that must be confirmed (payments, sending).
entries.build: Debounced saves, "Saved" state with time, conflict handling, warning before leaving with unsaved changes.

entries.what: A short list of first steps that leads a new account to the activation event.
entries.use_when: SaaS with a few setup steps.
entries.build: 3 to 5 steps, each linked to where it is done, dismissible, progress saved.

entries.what: An empty list explains what will appear there and offers the first action.
entries.use_when: Every list and dashboard that can be empty.
entries.build: One sentence, one primary button, sample data on request.

entries.what: Lets visitors pick the language, with each language named in itself.
entries.build: Names in their own language (Deutsch, Français); hreflang; the choice remembered; no automatic redirect without a way back.

entries.what: A list of what happened since the last visit, with unread marks.
entries.build: Bell with a count, mark as read, links to the object, email digest settings.

entries.what: ? opens a list of the keyboard shortcuts.
entries.build: A dialog grouped by screen, with the platform's symbols.

entries.what: Lets readers share a page.
entries.build: navigator.share on phones, plain links elsewhere (no third-party scripts that track); a good share image.
